transcription: Main article text only: the 'URL of this page:' line, the duplicate in-content H1 (served twice), the chapter navigation ('Topics in the … chapter' link list, 'Other chapters in Help Me Understand Genetics') and the closing medical-advice disclaimer removed; inline links flattened to their text. H1 title line from the page's own H1. Whitespace normalised, LF. The inheritance-pattern table is kept as pipe-separated rows including the header row.
purpose: library: the categories of single-gene inheritance as a comparison table — autosomal dominant (one altered copy of the gene in each cell is sufficient), autosomal recessive (variants in both copies; unaffected carrier parents), X-linked dominant and X-linked recessive (with the note that many X-linked disorders are not clearly dominant or recessive), Y-linked, codominant (two different alleles both expressed) and mitochondrial (maternal) inheritance, each row with its description and examples; plus reduced penetrance and variable expressivity, anticipation, genomic imprinting and uniparental disomy, and why some conditions are more common in particular ethnic groups. Fits a compare table of pattern × mechanism × examples, quiz cards with predict-then-reveal, and a concept map of the inheritance categories.
